mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = dc.descendant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE dc.ancestor_id = #{deptId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2)

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON gt.subject_id = dc.descendant_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = dc.descendant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE dc.ancestor_id = #{deptId} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_post p INNER JOIN dept_closure dc ON p.dept_id = dc.descendant_id INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = dc.descendant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE dc.ancestor_id = #{deptId} AND p.is_deleted = 0
